name: Mermaid CLI
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Text diagrams (flowchart, sequence, gantt) to SVG/PNG via headless Chromium
summary: Command line wrapper (mmdc) that renders Mermaid text diagrams (flowchart, sequence, gantt, class, state, ER) to SVG, PNG or PDF by driving headless Chromium via Puppeteer. Input is a .mmd file or Markdown with fenced blocks. Its strength is the quickest path from a readable text definition to a styled diagram, at the cost of a browser install.
use_when: Flowcharts, sequence diagrams or gantt charts from short text; over Graphviz for readable syntax
Diagrams for explainers where the default Mermaid theme is acceptable and layout need not be tuned
Generating SVG or transparent PNG from Markdown docs in a script
avoid_when: Large graphs needing layout control: Graphviz
Environment without Chromium or where startup time matters: Graphviz is a single native binary
Diagram elements must be animated with exact stable ids: hand-authored SVG
license: MIT; downloads a headless Chromium via Puppeteer
notes: 2026-10-26: Chromium download and Node version requirements of 12.0.0 not verified from source.

assessment.rationale: npm 12.0.0 published 2026-09-24, with 11.17.0 on 2026-09-02; MIT. Official wrapper for Mermaid; no neighbour offers the same text syntax. Requires Puppeteer-managed Chromium.
